name: 53144 · Kenosha, WI
findings: ZIP 53144 (Kenosha) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53144 (Kenosha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53144 (Kenosha) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
